Metadata.description: Metadata describing the origin and nature of a controls catalog.

type.description: Nature of the document: a standard, a framework, or a regulatory directive.
type.title: Document Type

name.description: Official name of the catalog (e.g. 'ISO/IEC 27001', 'NIST SP 800-53').
name.title: Name

version.description: Version or revision of the document (e.g. '2022', 'Rev 5'). Kept as string since it may contain non-numeric text.
version.title: Version

published.description: Original publication date of the document.
published.title: Published Date

last-modified.description: Date of the last modification/revision of the document.
last-modified.title: Last Modified

publisher.description: Entity responsible for publishing the document (e.g. 'ISO', 'NIST', 'CIS').
publisher.title: Publisher

description.description: Free-text, optional description of the catalog's purpose or scope.
description.title: Description

Metadata.title: Metadata

ref_code.description: Official reference code of the control (e.g. 'A.5.1', 'AC-2').
ref_code.title: Reference Code

slug.description: Unique, human-readable, URL-friendly identifier for this control (e.g. 'access-control', 'data-encryption').
slug.title: Slug

parent_slug.description: Slug of the parent control, if any. None for top-level controls.
parent_slug.title: Parent Slug

purpose.description: Purpose/intent of the control — why it exists.
purpose.title: Purpose

guidance.description: Implementation guidance — how to apply the control in practice.
guidance.title: Guidance

other_information.description: Catch-all field for additional information not covered elsewhere.
other_information.title: Other Information

means_of_verification.description: Ways to verify/audit compliance with this control.
means_of_verification.title: Means of Verification

attributes.description: Tag-like attributes, each mapping a key to a list of values (e.g. [{'security-level': ['high']}]).
attributes.title: Attributes

groups.description: Sub-controls or child controls of this control.
groups.title: Groups
